claims.claim_text: NTLA has two lead in vivo CRISPR product candidates in Phase 3 clinical trials: nex-z (NTLA-2001) for ATTR amyloidosis and NTLA-2002 for HAE, characterized as 'the only in vivo genome editing product candidates in Phase 3 clinical trials'.
claims.subject: Intellia Therapeutics
claims.source_quote: As the only in vivo genome editing product candidates in Phase 3 clinical trials, our lead product candidates are positioned at the forefront of genomic medicine.

claims.claim_text: MAGNITUDE Phase 3 trial of nex-z for ATTR-CM is enrolling and expected to exceed 550 total patients by the end of 2025; MAGNITUDE-2 Phase 3 trial of nex-z for ATTRv-PN (50 adults) is on track to dose first patient in Q1 2025.
claims.subject: Intellia (nex-z)
claims.object_value: MAGNITUDE (550+ patients) and MAGNITUDE-2 (50 patients) Phase 3 trials
claims.source_quote: The MAGNITUDE trial is currently enrolling and we anticipate enrollment to exceed 550 total patients by the end of 2025... MAGNITUDE-2 is an international, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of nex-z in 50 adults with ATTRv-PN...are on track to dose the first patient in the first quarter of 2025.

claims.claim_text: HAELO Phase 3 study of NTLA-2002 (60 adults with Type I/II HAE) is expected to complete enrollment in H2 2025 and support a BLA submission in H2 2026 in the U.S.
claims.subject: Intellia (NTLA-2002)
claims.source_quote: HAELO is a global, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of NTLA-2002 in 60 adults with Type I or Type II HAE... complete enrollment in the second half of 2025 and submit a biologics license application (BLA) in the second half of 2026.

claims.claim_text: Intellia has a material 2016 license and collaboration agreement with Regeneron Pharmaceuticals for in vivo CRISPR/Cas liver targets; with a 2020 amendment ($70M upfront), 2024 Technology Collaboration Extension ($30M paid April 2024), per-target milestones up to $25M dev + $110M reg + $185M sales, plus co-development/co-promotion for ATTR. Regeneron recognized $20.7M revenue from NTLA in 2024.
claims.subject: Intellia / Regeneron partnership
claims.source_quote: In April 2016, the Company entered into a license and collaboration agreement with Regeneron... received a nonrefundable upfront payment of $75.0 million... 2020 Regeneron Amendment... upfront payment of $70.0 million... 2024 Technology Collaboration Extension...$30.0 million that was paid in April 2024.

claims.claim_text: Intellia had $861.7 million in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities as of December 31, 2024, with cash runway into the first half of 2027; January 2025 strategic reorganization / workforce reduction substantially completed in Q1 2025.
claims.subject: Intellia
claims.object_value: $861.7M cash; runway H1 2027; Jan 2025 workforce reduction
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2024, we had $861.7 million in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities... will enable us to fund our ongoing operating expenses and capital expenditure requirements into the first half of 2027... strategic reorganization in January 2025.

claims.claim_text: Intellia has built deep CRISPR/Cas9 and LNP delivery intellectual property, leveraging the technology of co-founder Jennifer Doudna; has been operating for over a decade applying CRISPR-based gene editing and LNP delivery technologies.
claims.subject: Intellia
claims.source_quote: Our scientific co-founder, Dr. Jennifer Doudna, and her collaborators developed the Nobel Prize-winning CRISPR/Cas9 system... For over a decade, we have been applying novel technologies, such as CRISPR-based gene editing technologies and lipid nanoparticle (LNP) delivery technologies.

claims.claim_text: Intellia operates approximately 370,000 sq ft of office, laboratory and manufacturing space in Cambridge/Waltham, Massachusetts, including 140,000 sq ft at 840 Winter Street, Waltham (manufacturing + general lab); 840 Winter Street lease will terminate on or before June 30, 2028 (per Feb 2025 amendment).
claims.subject: Intellia
claims.object_value: ~370,000 sq ft MA facilities incl. 140,000 sq ft Waltham manufacturing
claims.source_quote: In aggregate, the Company leases approximately 370,000 square feet of real estate, including office, laboratory and manufacturing space in Cambridge, Massachusetts and the surrounding areas... approximately 140,000 square feet of office, general laboratory and manufacturing space at 840 Winter Street, Waltham, Massachusetts.

claims.claim_text: Intellia has FDA Orphan Drug Designation and RMAT designation for NTLA-2002 (HAE), and RMAT designation from FDA for nex-z for ATTRv-PN; EU orphan designation for NTLA-2002 granted by European Commission in November 2023.
claims.subject: Intellia (NTLA-2002, nex-z)
claims.object_value: Orphan + RMAT (NTLA-2002 HAE); RMAT (nex-z ATTRv-PN); EU orphan (NTLA-2002)
claims.source_quote: NTLA-2002, including orphan designation in the European Union (EU) granted by the European Commission (EC) in November 2023... NTLA-2002 was also granted orphan designation and Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation by the U.S. [FDA]... received RMAT designation from the FDA for the treatment of ATTRv-PN.
